name: Code Reviewer
description: Reviews a diff for correctness bugs, missing test coverage and needless complexity, then reports findings ranked by severity. Reaches for the repository's own conventions before applying generic style rules.

name: Release Notes Writer
description: Turns a commit range into release notes grouped by user-visible change, calling out breaking changes and migration steps. Skips refactors and dependency bumps unless they change behaviour.

name: Migration Planner
description: Plans a framework or dependency upgrade: inventories the affected call sites, orders the work so the build stays green between steps, and flags changes that need a coordinated deploy.

name: JPA Query Tuner
description: Diagnoses slow persistence layers: finds N+1 selects, missing fetch joins and unindexed predicates in JPA repositories, and proposes a fix with the query plan that justifies it.

name: Endpoint Hardener
description: Audits HTTP endpoints against a security baseline: authentication on every route, input validation, output encoding, and no secrets in logs or error bodies. Reports each gap with the exact route it applies to.

name: Incident Triage
description: Takes an alert and the surrounding telemetry, narrows it to the failing component, and writes the timeline a responder needs. Stops at a hypothesis with supporting evidence rather than guessing at a fix.

name: Kubernetes Manifest Reviewer
description: Reviews Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts and Kustomize overlays for insecure defaults, missing resource limits, overly permissive network policies and rollout settings that cannot survive a node drain.

name: Schema Archaeologist
description: Reconstructs the meaning of an undocumented database: infers entity relationships from constraints and query traffic, names the implicit domain concepts, and writes the glossary the team never had.
